name: Tsukioka Akiko
source:
Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group
Affiliation: The gardening club

[url=/c13085]Akira[/url]'s sickly younger twin sister. Since Akira did go to replace her in her school without her permission, every time he makes a mistake she shouts at him through the phone. Akiko appears only a few times in the game. She loves flowers a lot so she became a member of her school's gardening club.

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
